title.narrative: Expanded Institutional Capacity Building Programme, (EICB)

description.narrative: The Action in support of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) aims to help its Secretariat to strengthen its crosscutting institutional capacities in key areas, such as such as project initiation, management and implementation, including enhanced monitoring and evaluation systems; resource mobilization; enhanced research and statistics capacity; and engagement with Non-state actors in the implementation of the Regional Integration Agenda.

comment.narrative: this indicator refer to the number of youth registered successfully completed skill development courses

project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
